dedupe_keys.name: city of brussels aerial thermography of roofs january 2023

description: Ville de Bruxelles, Développement urbain publishes the reference to an aerial thermographic survey of all the roofs on the territory of the City of Brussels flown on 18 January 2023, which gives an inventory of heat loss from roofs with a precision of 40 cm; the dataset record itself holds a single row pointing to a map and further information on the city website. Coverage: the territory of the City of Brussels, Belgium; a single survey on 2023-01-18, record last modified on 2024-12-10, with irregular updates. Format and access: CSV, JSON, downloadable without registration from the Brussels open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC0 1.0; cost: free. Caveats: the open data record is a pointer (one row with the producer and web links), not the thermal raster; the heat-loss map is on the city website and was not opened. Simulation uses: building heat-loss screening for energy-renovation and district-heating planning, and calibration of building energy models. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
name: City of Brussels: aerial thermography of roofs (January 2023)
notes: Round 2 piece 14 (no-public-data visits): round 1 marked "Brussels Open Data (opendata.brussels)" as publishing no data; the portal was read on 2026-09-29.
